summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. disclosing a routine book sales contract between its subsidiary and Nanjing Fanshufang Culture Technology Co., Ltd. The agreement, valued at approximately US$1.20 million, covers the sale of K-12 educational books and related content services over one year. No special-situation elements—such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes—are present. The filing is an ordinary current report of a commercial contract. No deal terms apply.
